Source: Microchip SAM D21/DA1 Family data sheet, SERCOM USART register summary.
Public URL: https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/en/DeviceDoc/SAM-D21-DA1-Family-Data-Sheet-DS40001882H.pdf

SERCOM0 base address: 0x42000800

USART mode register summary
Offset Name
0x00 CTRLA Control A
0x04 CTRLB Control B
0x08 CTRLC Control C
0x0C BAUD Baud
0x0C BAUD Baud fractional mode
0x0E RXPL Receive pulse length
0x14 INTENCLR Interrupt enable clear
0x16 INTENSET Interrupt enable set
0x18 INTFLAG Interrupt flag status and clear
0x1A STATUS Status
0x1C SYNCBUSY Synchronization busy
0x28 DATA Data
0x30 DBGCTRL Debug control
